recentItems.title: Kouga Municipality launches municipal-scale Battery Storage System
recentItems.description:
The Kouga Municipality in the Eastern Cape has launched the country's first municipal-scale Battery Energy Storage System in the town of St Francis Bay.

The R24-million project is aimed at helping the municipality manage growing electricity demand, reduce costly peak-period electricity purchases, and restore power quicker when there are outages.

The municipality says this is the first phase of the project, with hopes to increase capacity in the future. 

Our reporter Sisipho Ngcumbe attended that launch.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Thabo Mbeki Foundation: 'SA must not abandon the redress policies'
recentItems.description:
The Thabo Mbeki Foundation has released a document that looked at the current tension between the United States of America and South Africa. 

In the document the history of the US on issues of slavery is captured as an example of how America tried to address the challenges that were faced by black African Americans. 

Thabo Mbeki Foundation CEO Max Boqwana says the decision by the United State of America to impose visa restrictions on some government officials was unfortunate - he also says South Africans must not be tired of correcting the disinformation that is being paddled against South Africa.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Carletonville Crime | Wedela residents pick up pieces after deadly shooting that claimed 18 lives
recentItems.description:
Wedela residents in Carletonville are still reeling from shock after a mass shooting incident that took place over the weekend. 

These residents say they are now forced to stay indoors in order to ensure their safety. 

The number of people who have died now has risen to 18. 

SABC News Reporter Calvin Dludla has more.

recentItems.title: Madlanga Commission rejects bid by Feroz Khan to delay his testimony for another month
recentItems.description:
The Madlanga Commission of Inquiry has rejected a bid by former Deputy Head of Crime Intelligence, Major-General Feroz Khan, to delay his testimony for another month, escalating tensions over his repeated failure to appear before the inquiry.

Khan was expected to finally give evidence before the commission on Monday.

recentItems.title: Thembisa Murder | 23-year-old woman shot and killed during alleged robbery
recentItems.description:
A 23-year-old woman has been shot and killed following an alleged robbery on Monday morning in Thembisa, east of Johannesburg. 

The woman was reportedly on her way to work just before 6am when the incident occurred. 

The deceased has been identified; however, her family is yet to be formally notified. 

Preliminary investigations have not established any link between this incident and the recent cases involving the bodies of women found in Ekurhuleni. 

No one has been arrested yet, and the police are investigating. 

SABC News Reporter Neria Hlakotsa is in Thembisa and joins us live.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: GBVF | Demonstrators call for an end to the killing of women
recentItems.description:
A group of women in Kempton Park are staging a demonstration to demand an end to the recent killing of women in Ekurhuleni.

According to police, at least 11 bodies of women have been discovered in various velds, near cemeteries and along railway lines in the metro in the past 10 weeks, eight of them this month alone. 

The 11th body was found semi-naked near Rhokana Road in Springs on Sunday.

Most of the victims were in their 20s and 30s, some found partially clothed with signs of sexual assault. 

For more, we cross to SABC News reporter Nomvuyo Ntanjana.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.
